name: lolcat
purpose: Colorize standard input text with rainbow ANSI gradients.
explanation: Reads text from standard input (or a file) and outputs it with rainbow colours in the terminal. Used as the final stage of `fortune | cowsay | lolcat`.
explanationOfOutput: Applies ANSI colour escape sequences to every character received via stdin.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to install `lolcat` via `brew install lolcat` first.
